title: Magenta Inventory
body:
Magenta Inventory
A simple, clean, and vibrant Resource Pack that refreshes your Minecraft GUI with a sleek Magenta theme. Perfect for players who want to add a unique aesthetic touch to their game interface without changing the core mechanics.

Features
Magenta GUI: A complete recolor of the Inventory, Crafting Table, and Container interfaces to a stylish Magenta palette.

Clean Design: Maintains the classic Minecraft layout while providing a fresh, cohesive look.

Optimized: A lightweight pack that runs smoothly on all setups.

Compatibility
Supported Versions: 1.16.2-1.16.5

Installation
Download the .zip file from the Files section.

Open your Minecraft Launcher and go to Options > Resource Packs.

Click Open Pack Folder.

Drag and drop the downloaded .zip file into that folder.

In the game menu, move the pack from the "Available" side to the "Selected" side.

Click Done and enjoy your new Magenta interface!
